# Anthropic Debuts; Trump's China Visit Puts Taiwan And Ukraine In Focus

![](https://thearorareport.com/wp-content/uploads/2026/11/2026-11-19_07h55_22.png)

#### **Two Way Money Flows**

Please click here for an enlarged chart of **Invesco QQQ Trust Series 1** [(NASDAQ:QQQ)](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/QQQ).

Note the following:

- The chart shows that QQQ  is rebounding this morning as positive sentiment builds for Anthropic’s (ANT) IPO and the momo crowd aggressively buys tech stocks in the premarket.
- The chart shows QQQ is still below the 200 day moving average.
- The chart shows QQQ had a drawdown of 15.2% from peak to trough.
- RSI on the chart shows QQQ is not oversold, contrary to popular belief.
- **Prudent investors should carefully watch to see if QQQ can break above the high band of zone 2 shown on the chart on Anthropic excitement.**
- **Anthropic PBC** (ANT) IPO was priced at \$83, above the prior range of \$70 – \$78 due to very high demand.  ANT IPO attracted nearly \$500B in reported demand, about six times the \$81.3B offering.
- **In our analysis, the IPO could trigger two way money flows in tech stocks.  **
  - Some investors may have sold other stocks to raise cash for the IPO.  As allocations are finalized, cash they no longer need could flow back into the market, helping tech stocks rebound.
  - Investors who received fewer ANT shares than they wanted may buy more when trading begins, pushing ANT higher.
  - On the other hand, investors eager to buy ANT in the open market may sell other technology stocks, especially AI stocks, to raise cash. This could put more pressure on already beaten down stocks.
- **In the grey market, ANT is trading at \$103.90 as of this writing.**
- The momo crowd is expecting ANT to quickly rocket over \$125.
- **Based on our decades of experience with IPOs, prudent investors should not ignore the possibility of ANT not trading as well as it appears at this time.  Remember, Space Exploration Technologies Corp (NASDAQ**:**SPCX) after the IPO shot up like a rocket due to aggressive momo crowd buying but then crashed below the IPO price.  **
- As a full disclosure, we have a signal to buy ANT.  It is worth a reminder to keep stops in the zone of \$82.83 – \$82.97.
- The U.S. economy is 70% consumer based, and **Walmart Inc** (WMT) is the largest retailer.  For this reason, Walmart earnings are important.  Walmart reported good earnings.  Here are the details:
  - Q3 adjusted EPS came at \$0.65 vs. \$0.64 consensus.
  - Q3 revenue came at \$188.8B vs. \$187.25B consensus.
  - Walmart guides FY27 adjusted EPS to \$2.84 – \$2.89 from prior \$2.80 – \$2.87.
- President Trump’s China visit has two elephants in the room for investors – Taiwan and the possible partition of Ukraine.
  - President Xi raised the Taiwan issue with President Trump. ** In our analysis, a big risk down the road for investors is any disruption to Taiwan’s semiconductor production, which is critical to the global AI supply chain.  Prudent investors should watch for any shift in President Trump’s position on Taiwan. **
  - President Trump and President Putin discussed Ukraine, but no deal has been announced. ** In our analysis, allowing Russia to keep occupied Ukrainian territory could have major implications for sanctions, oil prices, European stocks, and defense spending.**
- President Trump says he could allow the sale of **NVIDIA Corp**‘s (NASDAQ:[NVDA](https://www.benzinga.com/quote/NVDA)) Blackwell chips to China down the road.
- Initial jobless claims came at 203K vs. 199K consensus.  This indicates the employment picture is robust.
- FOMC minutes were hawkish and increase the probability of a rate hike in December.
- Leading Economic Index will be released at 10am ET and may be market moving.
- **At a time when most investors are focused on Anthropic, prudent investors should also pay attention that the probability of new U.S. strikes on Iran is jumping this morning.  **

#### **Magnificent Seven Money Flows**

Most portfolios are now heavily concentrated in the Mag 7 stocks.  For this reason, it is important to pay attention to early money flows in the Mag 7 stocks on a daily basis. 

In the early trade, money flows are positive in **Apple Inc** (AAPL), **Amazon.com, Inc.** (AMZN), **Alphabet Inc Class C** (GOOG), **Meta Platforms Inc** (META), **Microsoft Corp** (MSFT), **NVIDIA Corp** (NVDA), and **Tesla Inc** (TSLA).

In the early trade, money flows are positive in **SPDR S&P 500 ETF Trust** (SPY) and Invesco QQQ Trust Series 1 (QQQ).
